## Genesis & Biography
SILICIUM (sillic1um) is an underground dark phonk entity initiated in December 2022. The signature sonic architecture blends distorted 808 sub-bass, Memphis hip-hop vocal chops, atmospheric minor-scale synthesizers, and dark occult visual aesthetics.
The genesis track that launched the project is **"MY WEED"** (released December 14, 2022).
